SELECT 	ml.SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR 	,mp.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT 	,mp.SRC_SYS_CD 	,mp.LOGICAL_DELETE_IND 	,mp.EDIT_ERROR_IND 	,mp.PROVIDER_ID 	,mp.MBR_PCP_CHANGE_REASON_CD 	,mp.MBR_PCP_END_DT 	,mp.CREATE_DTTM 	,mp.CREATE_USER_ID 	,mp.UPDATE_DTTM 	,mp.UPDATE_USER_ID     , getdate() as current_dt     , 'PDS_Load_Member_PCP_Staging' as create_user FROM 	MEMBER_LOOKUP ml 		INNER JOIN MEMBER mb 			ON (    mb.MEMBER_ID = ml.MEMBER_ID 				  AND mb.SRC_SYS_CD = ml.SRC_SYS_CD) 		inner join (select                        p2.MEMBER_ID, max(p2.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT) as max_pcp_begin_dt                     from MEMBER_PCP p2                     WHERE                          (getdate() between p2.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT and p2.MBR_PCP_END_DT)                          and                           p2.LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = 'N'                     group by p2.MEMBER_ID                    ) current_pcp              ON current_pcp.MEMBER_ID = mb.MEMBER_ID          INNER JOIN MEMBER_PCP mp 			ON (mp.MEMBER_ID = mb.MEMBER_ID                 and mp.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT = current_pcp.max_pcp_begin_dt)

SELECT        ml.SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR        ,mp.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT        ,mp.SRC_SYS_CD        ,mp.LOGICAL_DELETE_IND        ,mp.EDIT_ERROR_IND        ,mp.PROVIDER_ID        ,mp.MBR_PCP_CHANGE_REASON_CD        ,mp.MBR_PCP_END_DT        ,mp.CREATE_DTTM        ,mp.CREATE_USER_ID        ,mp.UPDATE_DTTM        ,mp.UPDATE_USER_ID       , getdate() as current_dt     , 'PDS_Load_Member_PCP' as create_user    , 0 AS Alerted_Ind  FROM        MEMBER_LOOKUP ml              INNER JOIN MEMBER mb                      ON (    mb.MEMBER_ID = ml.MEMBER_ID                              AND mb.SRC_SYS_CD = ml.SRC_SYS_CD)              INNER JOIN (	SELECT  							  p2.MEMBER_ID, max(p2.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT) as max_pcp_begin_dt 							FROM MEMBER_PCP p2 							WHERE 								 (getdate() between p2.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT and p2.MBR_PCP_END_DT) 								 and  								 p2.LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = 'N' 							GROUP BY p2.MEMBER_ID 						) current_pcp 				ON current_pcp.MEMBER_ID = mb.MEMBER_ID  			INNER JOIN MEMBER_PCP mp                      ON (mp.MEMBER_ID = mb.MEMBER_ID 						and mp.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT = current_pcp.max_pcp_begin_dt)             INNER JOIN (	SELECT 								ml.SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR,                                 ml.SRC_SYS_CD,                                 mp.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT, 								COUNT(mp.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT) AS RECORDCOUNT 							FROM 								MEMBER_LOOKUP ml                                   INNER JOIN MEMBER mb                                          ON (    mb.MEMBER_ID = ml.MEMBER_ID                                                   AND mb.SRC_SYS_CD = ml.SRC_SYS_CD)                                   INNER JOIN (	SELECT                                                       p2.MEMBER_ID, max(p2.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT) as max_pcp_begin_dt                                                 FROM MEMBER_PCP p2                                                 WHERE                                                         (getdate() between p2.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT and p2.MBR_PCP_END_DT)                                                         and                                                          p2.LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = 'N'                                                 GROUP BY p2.MEMBER_ID                                             ) current_pcp                                          ON current_pcp.MEMBER_ID = mb.MEMBER_ID                                    INNER JOIN MEMBER_PCP mp                                          ON (mp.MEMBER_ID = mb.MEMBER_ID                                                 and mp.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT = current_pcp.max_pcp_begin_dt) 							GROUP BY ml.SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR,ml.SRC_SYS_CD,mp.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT 							HAVING COUNT(mp.MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT) > 1 						) sql1  					ON ml.SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR = sql1.SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR  ORDER BY ml.SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR
